REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (CONDUCT OF ELECTION)
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE
(CONDUCT OF ELECTION) RULES, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 9th January 1977]
S. R. O. 18 (1)/77.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 107 of the Representation of the
People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), the Election Commission, with the approval of
the President, is pleased to mate the following rules, namely
CHAPTER
I.‑PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and commencement.‑(11
These rules may be called the Representation of the People (Conduct of
Election) Rules, 19 ‑,17.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. Definitions.‑In these
ruler, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑

Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976) ;
(b) "Article" means

(c) "Form" means a
form appended to these rules and includes a translation thereof into any
language as may be approved by the Commission;
(d) "publish", with
its grammatical variations, includes exhibition at a place accessible to the
public ;
(e) "section" means
section of the Act ; and
(f ) "voter", in
relation to a seat‑
(i) reserved in the National
Assembly for women, means a member elected to a general seat in that Assembly
from the Province to which the seat relates ;
(ii) reserved in the National
Assembly for the persons referred to in clause (3) of Article 106, means a
member elected to a general seat in that Assembly ; and
(iii) reserved in a Provincial
Assembly for women or, as the case may be, for the persons referred to in
clause (3) of Article 106, means a member elected to a general seat in that
Assembly.
CHAPTER II. ‑CONDUCT
OF ELECTIONS TO THE? GENERAL SEATS
3. Nomination paper.‑(1) A nomination paper by which a
proposal is made under section 12 shall be in Form 1.
(2) A nomination paper which is
sent to the Returning Officer by post shall be attested by a magistrate or an
officer of the Federal Government or a Provincial Government in Grade 17 of the
National Pay Scale or a higher grade.
4. Security deposits for nomination.‑(1) The Returning
officer shall maintain a register m Form II in which he shall enter the
particulars of every cash deposit made to him under section 13 or of the hank‑draft accompanying a
nomination paper.
(2) Receipt of a cash deposit
or of a bang draft, as the case may be, by the Returning Officer shall be
acknowledged in Form III and the amount received in cash or through bank-draft
shall be deposited by him at a Govern?ment Treasury or Sub‑Treasury.
(3) The head of account for the
purpose of deposit at a branch of the State Bank of Pakistan or the National
Bank of Pakistan or at a Government Treasury or Sub‑Treasury shall be
"P.‑‑Deposits and Advances‑Part II‑
Deposits not bearing Interest‑Civil Deposits‑Deposits
in connection with election".
(4) The return of a deposit
which is required to be refunded under sub?section (1) of section 33 shall be
authorised under the seal and signature of the Returning Officer.
5. Appeal against rejection of nomination by the Returning
Officer.?(1) An appeal under subsection (5) of section 14 may be tilled by the
candidate himself or by a person authorised in writing by the candidate in this
behalf.
(2) The appeal shall be
addressed to the Commission and may be filed with the Secretary, Election
Commission, or with the Provincial Election Commissioner of the Province
concerned.
(3) An appeal shall be in the
form of a memorandum which shall
state the date of rejection of the nomination and the grounds of appeal and
unless the Commission dispenses with this requirement, shall be accompanied by
a certified copy of the order rejecting the nomination.
(4) The memorandum of appeal shall be submitted in quintuplicate.
(5) An appeal shall be disposed
of either summarily or after such summary inquiry as the Commission may
consider necessary.
